messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — elevated inference tail latency and intermittent 504s in us-west-2. Pager dispatched and war room created: https://zoom.redwood/room/omega-22

sasha: ack. on-call here. grabbing initial owner until we can hand off. joining war room.

liam: on my way in. checking autoscaler logs and GPU pool health. any immediate customer reports?

anya: seeing multiple customer reports for chat stalls and stream disconnects (small set of tenants). queued examples in war room notes. no telemetry gap but tail latency spike aligns with a big batch job at 20:04 UTC.

oncall-eric: pager got it. monitoring from mobile. if manual scale needed i can do it — give the green.

liam: triage quick notes: gpus in pool-a3 at high memory pressure, KV cache hit rate fell ~35%, worker-9 showing repeated `grpc: deadline exceeded` and stream resets.

sasha: assigning mitigation owner -> liam. i'll own customer comms and status copy.

liam: short mitigation plan: 1) manually add +2 nodes to pool-a3, 2) apply fallback rule to route non-critical traffic to quant-lite-3, 3) restart worker-9, 4) temporarily raise stream timeout to 50s to reduce 504s. executing now.

infra-mike: starting scale-up now. provisioning new GPU nodes.

liam: restarted worker-9, running cache-heap-scan. applying routing rule for tenant_tier=free.

oncall-eric: new nodes are booting. probed endpoint health — some reduction in retries. tail latency dropping from ~1.7s to ~1.0s at the 95th.

onya: draft status blurb below for review — will not post until comms lead says go.

onya: ```
Status: Degraded performance — us-west-2
Impact: A subset of customers may experience increased latency or interrupted streaming for generation and chat. No data loss: requests are retried and not dropped.
What we\u2019re doing: Engineers are scaling capacity and routing lower-priority traffic to fallback model variants. We\u2019ll update once performance normalizes.
ETA: ~20-30 minutes for visible improvement.
```

product-jordan: looks good. add note: "customer data integrity unaffected."

sasha: +1. hold public post until we confirm steady-state for at least 5m or 30m max. embargo for 3 minutes to confirm scale kicked off.

liam: scale completed +2 nodes online. cache probe showing high eviction rate; opening ticket INF-5010 to track root cause. streaming timeout bumped to 50s.

oncall-eric: confirming reduced retries and improved tail. 95th at ~0.88s now. continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: update logged — mitigation in progress. war room active. owner=liam, comms=sasha.

sasha: we hit steady-state at 20:28 UTC (95th < 0.9s). onya, please post status page using the approved draft and include "no data loss" and "customer data integrity unaffected."

onya: posted status page and sent targeted customer notifications for affected tenants. status link: https://status.redwood/incident/6567002222

sasha: handing to SRE for RCA. assigning INF-5010 to liam for 72h. closing immediate paging. thanks everyone. :tada:

liam: leaving war room, keeping INF-5010 open for memory/cache investigation. ping if any regressions.

incident-bot: incident marked resolved (impact reduced). final note appended. great collaboration."
